candidates.statement: Payment service shows elevated latency (p95 1600ms) with payment.authorize spans erroring at 1350ms and 9 downstream_deadline_exceeded 504 warnings, propagating to gateway 'call payment' errors at 911ms. This is consistent with downstream latency at payment degrading checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No deployment facts or dependency-level breakdown to pinpoint the latency source within payment; gateway/order/inventory metrics are healthy.

report.explanation: Payment metrics show p95 1600ms and error rate 0.004 with 504 deadline-exceeded logs and slow erroring authorize spans, while gateway/order/inventory remain healthy (p95 70ms). Evidence supports downstream latency at payment as the bounded root cause of checkout degradation.
missing_evidence: Payment dependency-level latency breakdown (e.g., DB/redis call timings) to localize the slow span
Deployment or configuration change records for payment in the incident window
